$comment: Toolchain and dependency baseline for the unified Web / desktop launcher plan (.blackhole/plan/unified-web-launcher.md, T0). Observed 2026-09-26 on the Windows x64 dev machine. 'planned' dependencies are not installed yet; lock exact versions when the owning task adds them and re-check licenses/advisories then.

versioningPolicy.testVsProduction: Test and Production share monotonic semver validation but are strictly isolated by environment, trust roots, AppId (StellarBridge.BlackHole.Desktop.Test vs StellarBridge.BlackHole.Desktop) and update feed.
versioningPolicy.sameVersionRule: Never overwrite an installed VSIX or running Desktop with a different build of the same semver while the host is running; bump PATCH for each new candidate or uninstall before clean test replacement.

go.verified: vet, test, -H windowsgui build, run, cross-build windows/darwin/linux x amd64/arm64 without runtime/cgo

node.gate: Core v2 requires >=22.13.0 (built-in node:sqlite); Desktop bundles one hash-pinned Node 22.20.0 executable outside the Node-free Core archive

innoSetup.scope: repository-local portable tools only; not system-installed
innoSetup.commercialLicense: unverified; compiler prints Non-commercial use only; release owner must confirm before commercial release

signing.windows: unknown - not verified; release blocker until provided
signing.macos: unknown - Developer ID and notarization credentials not verified; release blocker until provided
